verdict: Ascended Heroes has held its value better since release: AH26 81.01 (100 = Feb 2026) vs CR26 41.68 (100 = May 2026) at the Sep 28 mark (−19.0% in ~8 months vs −58.3% in ~4); at the same age (4 months) AH26's reconstructed level was 119.09 (Jun 2026, recon, labelled). Same verdict as Sep 30 (old Aug 24 base: −11.5% vs −14.7%, AH ahead at all five marks), gap far wider. Latest week −5.8% vs −8.5%. Top three sold-comp medians $2,167.40 vs $343.49. Chaos Rising is the far cheaper sealed entry: ETB lowest ask $69.99 (25 live) vs $149.00 (14), bundle $31.99 (43) vs $74.99 (40), CR factory booster box $179.99 (7 live), no AH factory box listing (Oct 2).
